plan.title: Donation Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Monthly trends, top cities, payment modes, repeat donors

panels.title: Total children
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM donor_transactions

panels.title: Top cities
panels.sql: SELECT "City" AS city, SUM("Amount") AS total FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY "City" ORDER BY "total" DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Monthly trend
panels.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', "Date") AS month, SUM("Amount") AS total FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

panels.title: Payment modes
panels.sql: SELECT "Mode" AS mode, SUM("Amount") AS amount FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY "Mode"

panels.title: Top 10 repeat donors
panels.sql: SELECT "Donor" AS donor, COUNT(*) AS donation_count FROM donor_transactions GROUP BY "Donor" ORDER BY "donation_count" DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: The dashboard shows the monthly donation trend, highlighting the most active cities and the distribution of payment methods. It also lists the top repeat donors who contribute most frequently. All figures are placeholders that will be replaced with actual values when the dashboard is rendered.
